related_work:
Tuesday was an exploration of the internet and how it came about to be. The first instruction was to "Break Microsoft" by creating an art piece that couldn't be made in Microsoft Word. A partner was then instructed to try and recreate this image using Microsoft Word.

I found out that there were 3 desires of the web, networking tech for the military, unifying computers into a single system and uniting all of the worlds knowledge, the first ever computer connection was made in 1969 and was the world LO.

We explored in a bit of detail the idea of a Creative Technologist as an Enlightenment Scholar, whose work intersects with science, art and technology. There was a discussion of the Memex, a hypothetical device which acted as memory, an index, which stored books, records and communication, and was an "enhanced supplement to memory." We were explained that, before the web and the internet, the only people who could peruse the world of a scholar would have already been invested in philosophy and science. 

We then explored the Information Processing Techniques Office (IPTO), which was based on the "Man-Computer Symbiosis" from 1960. It was started in October 1962 and was initiated by several Computer Science departments at universities, it was used for time sharing and networking and it inspired a primitive version of the Internet called ARPANET.
